title: e2ecp — a peer-to-peer file transfer tool that works through the web, CLI, or both  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Need to send files between machines fast with zero setup, zero cloud storage, zero trust issues? Meet E2ECP, a peer-to-peer file transfer tool that works through the web, CLI, or both. No accounts, no servers storing your stuff, just end-to-end encrypted transfers using P256 key exchange and AESGCM. The relay never sees your files, not even a bite. And it's built for real world networks, not perfect lab connections.
